description: This Java class 'OtaPackageUtil' provides utility methods for handling OTA (Over-The-Air) package attributes, telemetry keys, and package IDs based on package type (FIRMWARE or SOFTWARE). It includes static initialization of attribute key lists, methods for generating attribute and telemetry keys, and retrieving package IDs.

classes.name: OtaPackageUtil
classes.description: Utility class for OTA package attribute keys, telemetry keys, and package ID retrieval based on package type.

methods.name: getAttributeKeys
methods.description: Returns list of attribute keys for specified OTA package type (FIRMWARE or SOFTWARE).

methods.name: getAttributeKey
methods.description: Constructs attribute key string based on package type and key.

methods.name: getTargetTelemetryKey
methods.description: Generates telemetry key string for target OTA package attribute.

methods.name: getCurrentTelemetryKey
methods.description: Generates telemetry key string for current OTA package attribute.

methods.name: getTelemetryKey
methods.description: Helper method to generate telemetry key with a specified prefix.

methods.name: getOtaPackageId
methods.description: Retrieves the OTA package ID from an entity based on package type.

methods.name: getByOtaPackageType
methods.description: Returns a value from one of two suppliers depending on the OTA package type.
